name: provider-setup
title: Provider setup
description: A shadcn popover for configuring model access: pick any registered Pi provider and model, save an API key (masked, shows "saved"), run a device-code subscription sign-in (code, link and status), set an optional gateway and see when a provider needs one. Transport-agnostic: props in, callbacks out, no fetch. Owned, editable source; fits the pi-chat controls slot.
